sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Generated type hints for Next.js
sections.what: Gives the editor and compiler the type information for Next.js features such as image handling and global helpers. The file is created by Next.js itself.
sections.why: The file's own comment says it should not be edited and that Next.js manages it.
sections.watch_out: Any edit here is overwritten the next time Next.js regenerates the file.

summary: A generated file that gives TypeScript the type hints needed by Next.js.
purpose: Lets the editor and the build understand Next.js-specific types such as image and global helpers.
why: The file itself says it should not be edited, and Next.js creates it.
how: It has two reference lines that load Next.js type definitions and a comment. Nothing else runs.
inputs: None. It only refers to the Next.js package.
outputs: None at runtime. It only supplies type information.
risks: Edits are overwritten the next time Next.js regenerates the file.
debug: If type errors mention Next.js types, check that the Next.js package is installed and rerun the build so the file is regenerated.
